D.treatment: Ejs code tinkering and simulation modeling

O.outcome_detail: barriers and difficulty of implementing code-based modeling pedagogy

cells.quote: Established pen and paper education system and assessment makes it a challenge to create learning experiences through tinkering with the source codes, such as those possible with Ejs. Established school culture, teacher pedagogical understanding of meaningful learning, technology maturity and modeling skills are barriers to implementing these learning strategies. Steep learning curve on both the educators and the students is demanded for learning to modify codes in this new technology constructionism pedagogy.
cells.note: Authors' stated impediments section; no data were collected and no tested comparative result was reported.
